_provenance.baseline: ERA5 via Open-Meteo archive API, 2005-01-01 to 2024-12-31, Africa/Nairobi
_provenance.variables: daily precipitation_sum, et0_fao_evapotranspiration; temperature_2m_min where elevation >= 1900 m
_provenance.grid: 0.25 degrees, centroids snapped to the ERA5 grid; wards sharing a cell share normals
_provenance.statistics: rain_mm and et0_mm are monthly means over 20 years; rain_median_mm is the monthly median; p33_mm/p67_mm are tercile band edges; sample_years is the smallest per-month count
_provenance.wards_source: geoBoundaries gbOpen KEN ADM3 (CC BY 4.0), see web/boundaries/index.json
